concepts.name: 双向数据通道
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: distinctive desktop app icon concept for Bandix, a network traffic monitoring, bandwidth and device management application.
Exactly ONE centered icon on a square canvas. A premium rounded-square app tile occupies about 88% of the canvas with genuinely transparent empty margins. Create a coherent, memorable standalone SYMBOL, absolutely no letters, no B, no monograms, no word Bandix, no typography.
Professional restrained visual design, large clean geometric forms, strong negative space, legible at 24–32 pixels, minimal flat vector-like appearance with subtle color depth. The network traffic meaning must be conveyed in the symbol itself, not by adding little badges.
Avoid: collages, presentation sheets, screenshots, mockups, text, watermark, tiny circuit details, thin strokes, excessive gradients, glossy 3D, floating particles, external shadows. Clean alpha edges.
Subject: two thick interwoven directional ribbons forming a single compact diagonal linked diamond silhouette, like a pair of network data streams crossing a junction. One ribbon is bright turquoise flowing toward upper right, the other is warm orange flowing toward lower left. Each has one clear simple arrowhead at its endpoint. Keep the central crossing simple, the open center spacious, no letter shape, no circular refresh symbol. Beautiful balanced asymmetry with confident wide strokes. Deep midnight navy tile. A modern recognizable emblem for inbound and outbound traffic.
